entries.title: Historical arithmetic projection
entries.description: A deliberately selected projection of arithmetic invariants into geometric coordinates. α is a historical scaling parameter, not a physical conversion.
entries.caveat: Does not establish a unique mapping, bijection, rank–time equivalence, or cosmic correspondence.

entries.title: Mapping-family comparison
entries.description: Modular j-invariant, primarily algebraic and Frobenius-trace families are alternative controls to the historical mapping.
entries.caveat: No mapping family is independently validated as a cosmic coordinate system.

entries.title: BSD-inspired cosmological Dirichlet series
entries.description: In the supplied historical report, a_n counts galaxies in bins of log stellar mass, redshift and Petrosian radius. This is a constructed statistic, not an elliptic-curve L-function.
entries.caveat: The report's average five-fold MSE 0.4266 is an unverified historical claim, not controlled SFR performance. Bin indexing and target leakage require independent audit.

entries.title: Finite positive bin-count series cannot vanish at s=1
entries.expression: a_n ≥ 0 and Σa_n > 0  ⇒  L_cosmo(1) = Σ_(n=1)^B a_n/n > 0
entries.description: For finitely many nonnegative galaxy-bin counts, any occupied bin makes the Dirichlet sum positive at s=1. This is a mathematical limitation of the reported rank analogy, not a claim about physical data.
entries.caveat: Therefore a nonzero derivative L′_cosmo(1) does not establish a first-order zero, BSD rank one, or a number of independent star-formation drivers.

entries.title: Historical additive SFR predictor hypothesis
entries.expression: SFR ~ a·logmass + b·z + c·L_cosmo(1) + d·dec + e·petroRad_r + f·environment + g·(logmass·z)
entries.description: The uploaded report presents a symbolic additive candidate using ordinary astrophysical quantities and the bin-count statistic alongside a Random Forest training narrative.
entries.caveat: Random Forest feature importance does not estimate coefficients a through g. The displayed equation has no verified coefficient fit, protected split or independently reproduced performance.

entries.title: Historical five-fold SFR metric — unreplicated
entries.description: The historical report gives five fold-level values and an aggregate, retained as reported provenance only.
entries.caveat: No audited inputs, training-only transformations, split indices, model coefficients, null comparison, or independent holdout verifies these numbers. The reported aggregate is not controlled statistical or cosmological evidence.

entries.title: Topological descriptors
entries.expression: β₀: components · β₁: independent loops · β₂: cavities
entries.description: These are mathematical meanings of Betti numbers in the chosen filtration. Persistent homology describes topology across scales.
entries.caveat: β₁ is not the number of astronomical filaments and β₂ is not automatically the number of cosmological voids.

entries.title: Research dependency chain
entries.expression: Arithmetic → Geometry → Topology → Observation → Dynamics → Physics
entries.description: A methodological ordering from Charter v0.2. Physical interpretation is downstream of independently tested observational correspondence.
entries.caveat: Arrows express a proposed research workflow, not a proven causal or physical reduction.

entries.title: Registered Einstein–dust evolution reduction
entries.description: A class-restricted Szekeres–Szafron metric reduction documented in the registered E1a derivation.
entries.caveat: Subject to the registered assumptions and reviewer audit; not a theorem that arithmetic geometry causes cosmic structure.

entries.title: Spherical SDSS–MaNGA matching reconstruction
entries.expression: inputs → coordinate audit → spherical search → rejection/null tests → versioned outputs
entries.description: A prospective reconstruction pathway for two historically invalid 1,495-row matched outputs.
entries.caveat: No reconstructed match is certified. The historical two-arcsecond failures remain negative data-quality evidence.

entries.title: Exterior derivative consistency condition
entries.expression: If θ = dℳ, then dθ = d(dℳ) = 0
entries.description: For a globally defined smooth scalar ℳ, the exterior derivative is nilpotent: d²ℳ=0.
entries.caveat: A nonzero cohomology class cannot follow from d(dℳ); it requires a separate closed non-exact structure.

entries.title: Recovered CasJobs notebook output
entries.description: A saved output derivative from the recovered CasJobs.ipynb. The full original notebook and execution environment have not been certified by this entry.
entries.caveat: The JSON file is inert provenance, not an executable or independently reproducible notebook.
